Name: 2 m air temperature
Definition: Monthly mean air temperature 2 m above the surface (ensemble mean)
Notes: Checked against the file: variable `air` with `units` attribute `degK`, read as kelvin; `valid_range` 100 to 500 K.

Name: Precipitation rate
Definition: Monthly mean precipitation rate at the surface (ensemble mean)
Notes: Checked against the file: variable `prate` with `units` attribute `kg/m^2/s`. Already a rate, so no accumulation period; a mass of water per area reads as a depth by the density of water, so 1 kg m^-2 s^-1 is 1 mm s^-1.

Name: Downward short-wave radiation flux
Definition: Monthly mean downward (incident) short-wave radiation flux at the surface (ensemble mean)
Notes: Checked against the file: variable `dswrf` with `units` attribute `W/m^2`. Already a rate. Incident rather than net: the net short-wave flux is `dswrf` minus `uswrf`, a combine over the two layers.

Name: Upward short-wave radiation flux
Definition: Monthly mean upward (reflected) short-wave radiation flux at the surface (ensemble mean)
Notes: Checked against the file: variable `uswrf` with `units` attribute `W/m^2`. Already a rate; the reflected half of `dswrf`.

Name: Soil moisture content
Definition: Monthly mean volume of water per volume of soil in the top soil layer (ensemble mean)
Notes: Checked against the file: variable `soilw` with `units` attribute `frac.`, dimensionless, on a `level` axis of four layer tops (0, 10, 40 and 100 cm). The vertical extent selects the top layer, and the read multiplies the fraction by its 10 cm thickness to give a depth of water over the cell.
